stories.new_fact: An Ohio court ruled the private-school voucher program unconstitutional, and the state said it would appeal.
stories.new_takeaway: Families and participating schools should separate the present court ruling from the eventual appellate outcome when planning enrollment and budgets.
stories.why_now: The court decision and stated appeal occurred October 15.
stories.previous_coverage: No school-voucher constitutional segment appeared in the prior seven scripts.
stories.uncertainty: The appellate timetable and any stay were not established at cutoff.
stories.watch: State appeal filing and any request to pause the ruling.

stories.new_fact: WOSU reported that Acton's campaign barred reporters from a student rally near Ohio State and did not take questions afterward, while Ramaswamy appeared at a community forum.
stories.new_takeaway: For Central Ohio voters, recurring accessible forums provide more testable policy information than a controlled rally alone.
stories.why_now: The events and report are dated October 14.
stories.previous_coverage: No campaign-access segment appeared in the prior seven scripts.
stories.uncertainty: One event does not establish either campaign's overall openness or policy capacity.
stories.watch: Subsequent Central Ohio forums and on-the-record policy exchanges.

stories.new_fact: MPF announced that from December 1 MPF Xtra participants must submit escrow events separately and report directly to Computershare in Excel, CSV or JSON; ASCII files are not accepted.
stories.new_takeaway: The immediate lending risk is a servicing data-handoff and reconciliation failure, not a borrower-credit or rate change.
stories.why_now: The new requirement was announced October 15 and has a December 1 implementation deadline.
stories.previous_coverage: Prior lending segments covered VA delivery, credit scores, guide changes and lender economics; not this escrow-event reporting conversion.
stories.uncertainty: The announcement does not disclose participant readiness, field mapping or expected error rates.
stories.watch: MPF implementation clarifications, sample layouts and reported conversion exceptions.

stories.new_fact: Bank of America reported more than 200,000 teammates using AI tools and more than 300 approved use cases.
stories.new_takeaway: Enterprise adoption counts are an implementation input, not a measured result for a particular bank decision.
stories.why_now: The Q3 earnings release dated October 14 newly disclosed the scale figures.
stories.previous_coverage: October 15 discussed Starling's announced transaction-model infrastructure, not Bank of America's enterprise adoption count and missing task-level outcomes.
stories.uncertainty: The release names no individual use case, baseline, quality result, customer metric or cost result for the reported aggregate.
stories.watch: Named production use case with a disclosed baseline and outcome.
stories.ledger_row_changed: Added Bank of America / enterprise internal productivity and risk-management AI adoption as production-scale company disclosure, with 200,000 teammates and 300-plus approved use cases but no task-level outcome metric.

stories.new_fact: OpenAI release notes announced GPT-Live-1.1, GPT-Live-1.1 Quip and expanded voice and accent options in ChatGPT Voice.
stories.new_takeaway: Voice-version changes need workflow-specific testing because a more natural conversational surface is not a measured improvement in a regulated task.
stories.why_now: The release notes are dated October 15.
stories.previous_coverage: October 15 covered xAI Grok Voice 3.0 API migration; this is a different provider, product surface and evidence limitation.
stories.uncertainty: OpenAI did not publish a prior-version comparison for latency, task completion, transcription error or accessibility in the cited release notes.
stories.watch: Version-specific evaluation results, workflow-relevant latency and error data, and enterprise-control documentation.
stories.frontier_bar: New capability and access shift for a named voice-model version.

stories.new_fact: Bank of America reported third-quarter net income of $6.9 billion and higher average loans and leases year over year.
stories.new_takeaway: Broad bank earnings do not establish a universal mortgage-pricing or household-credit outlook.
stories.previous_coverage: October 15 used the same release for home-loan mix, while this compact segment makes a different, limited markets inference.
stories.uncertainty: One bank's release is not a sectorwide credit forecast.
stories.watch: Peer earnings, credit-loss commentary and actual borrower pricing.

stories.new_fact: NWS forecast rain showers before 3 PM, a high near 69, falling afternoon temperatures and gusts up to 28 mph.
stories.new_takeaway: Allow extra wet-commute time and secure lightweight outdoor items.
stories.previous_coverage: Routine weather coverage; it does not satisfy the freshness count.
stories.uncertainty: Rain timing and wind can shift with forecast updates.
stories.watch: NWS forecast updates through the afternoon.
